PetroVietnam Exploration Production Corp Ltd Unveils New Oilfield Equipment Line

HANOI — PetroVietnam Exploration Production Corp Ltd, a prominent player in Vietnam's oil and gas sector, today announced the launch of a new line of oilfield equipment aimed at enhancing operational efficiency across the nation’s energy projects. The unveiling took place at the company’s headquarters in Hanoi, drawing attendance from industry experts, local officials, and representatives of partner enterprises.

According to the company, the newly launched equipment includes advanced drilling rigs, automated monitoring systems, and environmentally friendly extraction technologies, all designed with the goal of increasing productivity while minimizing environmental impact. The equipment line, developed in partnership with leading engineering firms, is expected to be deployed in both onshore and offshore projects over the coming year.

Mr. Nguyen Van Thanh, General Director of PetroVietnam Exploration Production Corp Ltd, highlighted the significance of the launch for both the company and the broader Vietnamese energy sector. “This initiative reinforces our commitment to leveraging technology for sustainable growth,” he said during the event. “By investing in modern equipment, we not only improve our operational efficiency but also contribute to national efforts in ensuring energy security and protecting the environment.”

Industry analysts point out that the introduction of the new equipment comes at a time when Vietnam is seeking to increase domestic oil and gas output to meet rising energy demand. According to data from the Vietnam Oil & Gas Association, the nation’s crude oil production in 2023 stood at approximately 9.1 million tonnes, with expectations for modest growth in the coming years.

Ms. Le Hoang Mai, an energy sector analyst at Quang Duy Consulting, noted, “The move by PetroVietnam Exploration Production Corp Ltd is timely. Advanced technology is crucial for optimizing existing fields and exploring new reserves, especially as extraction conditions become more challenging.”

The company also announced training programs for its operational teams to ensure smooth integration of the new equipment. “We are investing in our people alongside our technology,” added Mr. Thanh. “Safety and technical expertise remain our top priorities.”

Local suppliers and service providers welcomed the development, with Mr. Pham Duc Long, chairman of the Hanoi Oilfield Services Cooperative, stating, “This launch will create new business opportunities for local partners and support the growth of supporting industries.”

PetroVietnam Exploration Production Corp Ltd confirmed that the rollout of the new equipment will commence in Q3 2024, starting with key projects in the Cuu Long and Song Hong basins. The company anticipates a 12% improvement in operational efficiency as the technology is fully implemented over the next 18 months.
